title: feat(nm2cycfrmz): HOLDING cyclic-frame transport of (m,o_next,o_prev) at t+1 on two-axis opposite z-probes: reverse HOLD, face HOLD
science: Head of the frame-TRANSPORT family: transport(q) HOLDs iff split HOLDs, Orient=+/-1, and some formed 6-NN r admits a sending P=F(q)^T F(r) that is a signed permutation with det P = Orient(q)Orient(r). DEFECT: both conditions are identities. F(q),F(r) are always signed-permutation matrices, so P always is and det P always equals Orient(q)Orient(r) — verified exhaustively over all 2304 ordered pairs
